text:
ASTLEY DOWN — The annual Larkmere kite festival is hosted by Astley Down, according to people familiar with the matter and the organisers' own records.

The 2025 edition ran 14-15 June, as listed in the published event calendar. Marguerite Oyelaran, Festival Director of the Larkmere Kite Guild, confirmed Astley Down as the host town.

Attendance reached 18,400 over the two days, with 212 registered kite flyers taking part, people familiar with the matter said. The figures appear in the Larkmere Kite Guild's Annual Report 2025, which was presented at a press briefing held at Astley Down Town Hall on 20 June.

The Guild has not announced further details of the festival's arrangements. Meridian Brief will report any updates as they become available.
